verdict.rationale: Otter documents a notetaker that can be scheduled to auto-join Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet, plus bot-free desktop recording and bot-free Google Meet capture, so the core multi-platform capture exists. Reliability and control over where recording happens are not evidenced; community reports describe the bot joining meetings users didn't intend and being hard to stop, and one user found accuracy weaker with varied accents. missing for 10: evidence of reliable capture across all three platforms, documented per-meeting control over when and where recording happens (auto-join vs. opt-in), independent corroboration that unwanted auto-joins can be prevented.

support.subject: As a product manager, the notetaker reliably captures Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams meetings, with recording where I want it

citations.quote: Schedule your AI Meeting Notetaker to automatically join all your Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet meetings.
Record conversations directly from your Mac or Windows desktop, without bots joining the call.
Capture impromptu Google Meet calls without a bot present
Record bot-free and manage meetings directly through the Otter desktop app
